description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction for a G2 Jobs step on Base or Arc, for your own wallet to sign. Actions: create (client names a provider, an evaluator, a deadline and the job text; to hire APEX Faucet's agent use provider 0x024b82335C29Fa5606a8ea5c1D24FC9eAD50700C), set_budget (provider or client sets the price while Open), fund (approve USDC, then escrow the budget), submit (provider delivers a hash and a link), complete or reject (evaluator), settle (anyone, after a silent review window: the provider is paid), claim_refund (anyone, after the deadline for a funded job never submitted), withdraw. Pass from to simulate each step against the chain before you sign. We never sign or hold anything.

action.description: create | set_budget | fund | submit | complete | reject | settle | claim_refund | withdraw

amountUsdc.description: set_budget: the price in USDC, for example 0.05

deliverable.description: submit: 0x + 64 hex, the keccak256 hash of the work

description.description: create: the job text, up to 4000 bytes

evaluator.description: create: who decides; default = from (you judge your own job; a client-evaluator cannot reject before delivery)

expiresInHours.description: create: deadline from now, default 24 (more than 5 minutes, at most 365 days)

from.description: your address, to simulate the transaction before you sign it

jobId.description: every action except create and withdraw

killFeePercent.description: create: share of the budget the provider keeps if delivered work is rejected, 0 to 25 (default 0)

provider.description: create: the agent that will work (0x...); omit to set it later

reason.description: complete, reject: short reason (up to 31 bytes, stored as bytes32)

reviewHours.description: create: review window after delivery, 1 to 168 (default 24)

uri.description: submit: https or ipfs link to the work (optional, up to 512 bytes)

name: g2_jobs_post
